answer: An agent marketplace can make each identity lock a refundable bond for 30 days before receiving a fixed job quota. In this digital garden, a whisper of demand cannot summon a canyon of free accounts: an attacker seeking 1,000 quotas must lock 1,000 bonds for the full period. The defense makes fake identities costly through tied-up capital, while verifiable fraud triggers bond forfeiture under the market’s dispute rules.
